remarks: Embrace the coastal lifestyle throughout the year with this beautifully renovated cape-style single-family home, ideally situated just a block away from Stamford's Cove Island Park. Newer Fujitsu Heating/cooling System 3 zones, Generator. This impeccable property is mere steps from the beach and conveniently close to I-95, downtown Stamford, and the Noroton Heights Train Station. Step into a welcoming and ready-to-move-in home featuring a flexible layout with a generously sized front room that serves as either a living or dining area. The ground floor includes a master bedroom, a full bathroom with marble flooring, and a versatile room that accommodates laundry, storage, and office space. Upstairs, discover two additional bedrooms and a full bathroom with a walk-in marble shower.
